techniques.evidence: src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/archetypes/PrimaryArchetypeLifecycle.tsx:37 The catalogId-to-type assertion is made at each call site rather than enclosed behind one checked accessor, and no comment states why it is valid.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/ai-logic/AILogicTab.tsx:33 Detection is a pure function of entity positions and the sense profile, which lives in lib/bestiary/sense-profile and is called with values.
src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/index.tsx:22 The rule for picking the subject is owned by the same lib module that owns sense profiles, not restated in the shell.

src/components/modules/core-engine/sub_bestiary/ai-logic/bt-flowchart-utils.ts:20 The descendant walk uses an explicit loop over a stack plus a visited set, a stateful traversal where the sequential form is the natural one.
